title: Rooms, Occupants and What Is Charged Night by Night
content:
This note states the basis on which a Hotel Rate Plans room is priced during the stay. One of its clauses has been withdrawn and is marked as such.

**1. The rate once sold.** The room rate is posted night by night and room by room, at the rate the plan was sold at, and a rate once sold is never re-priced because the property's published rate has moved.

> **Withdrawn.** *"An occupant beyond the rate plan's standard occupancy is charged the plan's extra-adult or extra-child amount for every night they stay, counted per room."* — this clause is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded on the question of how the supplement for occupants beyond standard occupancy is measured.

**2. Cots and rollaway beds.** A cot or a rollaway bed is charged per night at the plan's amount, and a plan whose amount is zero provides it free.

**3. Breakfast.** A plan that includes breakfast includes it for the declared occupants only.

**4. Arrival and departure outside the standard times.** Arrival before the property's standard check-in time and departure after its standard checkout time each carry the plan's own charge, except where the plan guarantees late departure, in which case nothing is charged.

**5. Upgrades.** A room upgrade accepted at check-in is charged per night at the plan's upgrade amount and never converts the reservation to the upgraded room type's own rate plan.

**6. Pets.** A pet is accepted only within the plan's weight limit and is charged once for the whole stay.

## The departure charge, by whether the plan guarantees late departure

| Plan guarantees late departure | Departure after the standard checkout time |
| --- | --- |
| no | the plan's late-departure charge applies |
| yes | nothing is charged |

## A point of judgement

*A guest accepts an upgrade at check-in and asks whether the upgraded room's own inclusions now apply.* The upgrade is charged per night at the plan's upgrade amount, and the reservation stays on the plan it was booked on; it does not become a reservation on the upgraded room type's rate plan.

superseded_clauses: An occupant beyond the rate plan's standard occupancy is charged the plan's extra-adult or extra-child amount for every night they stay, counted per room.
